description: This file contains unit tests for the 'db_functions.py' module in the BORIS behavioral software project. It uses pytest to run tests that load and verify event data from JSON files into a database, checking for correct query execution and data integrity.

classes.name: Test_load_events_in_db
classes.description: Test class for testing the load_events_in_db function, contains methods for different test scenarios.

classes.name: Test_load_aggregated_events_in_db
classes.description: Test class for testing the load_aggregated_events_in_db function, covers scenarios including successful load and error conditions.

methods.name: test_1(self)
methods.description: Tests loading events for a specific subject and observation, verifies correct database querying and output formatting.

methods.name: test_2(self)
methods.description: Tests loading events for another subject and observation with multiple codes, verifies output correctness.

methods.name: test_3(self)
methods.description: Tests scenario with no focal subject and unmatched events, verifies handling of edge case.

methods.name: test_dump(self)
methods.description: Verifies dumping of database contents after loading aggregated events.

methods.name: test_not_ok(self)
methods.description: Tests loading of aggregated events for an observation with unpaired state events, expecting failure.

methods.name: test_no_observation(self)
methods.description: Tests loading with no observations specified, expecting failure.
